notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with power 4 or greater.
description:
Activate Leafkin Avenger by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Leafkin Avenger.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Leafkin Avenger.
Repeat.
